title: Shatter-Top Crème Brûlée
hookLine: Velvety Madagascar vanilla bean custard topped with a paper-thin caramelized sugar glass.

steps.title: Set Up Heavy Saucepan & Ingredients
steps.instructionTemplate: Place a heavy-bottomed saucepan over medium-low heat and have a heatproof silicone whisk ready. Measure out {cream_cb} and {yolks_cb} and {sugar_cb} and {van_cb} in advance—stovetop desserts move fast once they start bubbling.

steps.title: Whisk Warm Cream Into Yolks
steps.instructionTemplate: Simmer {cream_cb} with {van_cb}. Whisk {yolks_cb} and {sugar_cb}, then slowly stream warm cream in while whisking continuously. Stir gently over low to medium-low heat until completely dissolved and glossy, scraping the sides so nothing crystallizes or scorches.

steps.title: Bake Gently & Chill
steps.instructionTemplate: Pour into ramekins set in a hot water bath. Bake at 325°F (165°C) for 35 minutes until edges set with a slight center wobble. Chill 3 hours.

steps.title: Sprinkle Sugar & Torch Until Glassy
steps.instructionTemplate: Sprinkle 1 tbsp sugar per ramekin and torch (or broil 2 mins) until bubbling amber. Wait 60 seconds for the iconic spoon crack! Plate into 4 generous servings while the flavors and textures are at their peak, and store any leftovers covered.
steps.creatorSecret: Rest 60 seconds after torching so the sugar hardens into an ASMR glass sheet.

ugcQuotes.quote: Turned out bakery-grade on my first try! Ready in 45 mins.
